_comment: Per-track verified corrections. Path keys are relative to docs/midi-files/. Recognised fields per entry: perceived_bpm (overrides IOI heuristic), beat_one_tick (raw-tick offset where the music's audible beat-1 sits; defaults to 0), meter (e.g. "4/4", "6/8", "3/4"; overrides the file's first time-signature event). Empty / missing fields fall back to auto-detected values.
